channel.description: Posts in the discussion thread "The Price of Beauty"

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
Thank you, I appreciate the feedback (:

I always find the most disturbing horror is the things people are willing to do to themselves - not when they're necessarily compelled by an anomalous object or force. Although I may expand this in the future to include the Ana Mirror, which has no compulsive element in itself either; just links it to the Foundation'verse a bit more.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
That's quite… interesting. If you're going to replace your teeth, I'd recommend having the replacements on hand, as teeth are, well, sort of important.

Honestly though, I came here expecting some body-swapping or beauty stealing, but you've made something even more disturbing. This is truly, impressively, creepy. Good job.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: And teeth. Can't forget teeth. *Shudder.* But I'm glad it communicated that creepy rating that can be hard to explain in narrative form. I was unsure how well I handled it here.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: Gaaah. Body dysmorphia and body horror - two dreadful tastes that taste worse together. Definitely a high creepy rating.

And also body dysmorphia is not very nice to people or those who love them.
